product_metadata.title: Now Designs Spectrum Placemats Ribbed Cotton, Chili Red, 19x13 inches, Set of 4, (901495aa)
features: Rich color and vertical ribbing bring warmth and texture to your table settings. Chili red - set of 4. Each placemat measures 19 x 13 inches
Thick construction delivers excellent tabletop protection from spills and scratches
Made from 100% cotton with a thick ply ribbed weave
Spot clean between washing. For best results, machine wash warm, lay flat to dry. Do not bleach

Now Designs is a collection of kitchen and dining essentials designed to celebrate and support the joy of living well. Reimagined classics and an abundance of colors and tones to appeal to every taste.
description: Reignite your style and add flair to dining tables with Spectrum Chili Red Placemats by Now Designs. A trusted staple in homes for many years, these cloth placemats are perfect for everyday meals and just as easily transition to an elegant table setting with seasonal accessories. From vibrant shades to easy-match neutrals, the eye-catching solid colors complement an array of patterned, printed or monochrome kitchen linens and dishware. Mix and match these placemats with the entire line of Spectrum napkins and tablecloths—the range of colors pairs beautifully for a coordinated look. The most delicious meals can be messy so rely on the hefty, multi-ply design to protect your table from accidental spills and drops. The basic styling and gorgeous colors of these cotton placemats bring classic accents to casual gatherings and festive family get-togethers indoors or out. Charming simplicity lets you dress up or dress down your table setting to suit your decor or occasion. A thick, ribbed construction of 100% cotton makes Spectrum Placemats extremely durable and ideal for everyday use. Generously sized at 19 x 13 inches, these fabric placemats provide ample room for a large plate and all your utensils. To ensure your placemats continue to look great through years of dinners with friends and family, after machine washing or spot cleaning, lay flat to dry.
